fatal_failures: the exact public static ExpandIssuance(BdtMessage) entry point or required public support types are absent
a tranche override mutates or leaks into a programme default, sibling output, or previously emitted CDM security
a valid later tap emits a second Security with the same ISIN instead of increasing the existing issue size
a conflicting tap is silently accepted or resolved with last-writer-wins
the implementation replaces the typed CDM 7.0.0 Security boundary with an invented security model or edits generated model code

criteria.description: Expose the exact expansion contract and fail-closed result model.
checks: Compile and invoke benchmark.issuance.BdtTrancheExpander.ExpandIssuance directly.
Expose the required input, output, validation-code, failure, and result types.
Return non-null typed lists and make valid() agree with failures.isEmpty().

criteria.description: Resolve programme defaults independently without sideways override leakage.
checks: Three unique rows with only the middle currency overridden emit GBP, EUR, GBP in first-occurrence order.
Issuer and governing-law inheritance and overrides are likewise isolated per row.
Expansion neither mutates the programme and input list nor aliases mutable working state across outputs.

criteria.description: Detect missing source rows through the declared-total checksum.
checks: Sum every input row's issue size, including taps, using exact BigDecimal arithmetic.
Compare numerically without scale sensitivity and without an invented FX conversion.
A mismatch emits AGGREGATE_SIZE_MISMATCH and no securities.

criteria.description: Merge a genuine later fungible tap by ISIN identity.
checks: A matching later duplicate emits one security for the ISIN and increments issue size exactly.
The output keeps the first issue date, records the latest tap date, and preserves first-appearance ordering.
A same-day or earlier duplicate emits NON_LATER_TAP and no securities.

criteria.description: Fail loudly when an ISIN re-opening changes fungibility terms.
checks: Detect coupon, maturity, resolved issuer, resolved governing-law, and resolved-currency conflicts.
Resolve null and explicit-equal overrides before comparing terms.
A conflict emits CONFLICTING_TAP_TERMS, no partial output, and never last-writer-wins.

criteria.description: Build the intended CDM 7.0.0 security identity and issuer topology.
checks: Each unique ISIN maps to a real Security with exactly one ISIN AssetIdentifier, SECURITY asset type, and DEBT security type.
Each Security has exactly one Party with exactly one LEI PartyIdentifier matching the resolved issuer.
Its ISSUER AssetPartyRole resolves to that party; issuance-only facts stay in the explicit ExpandedSecurity sidecar.

criteria.description: Reject malformed data predictably and return stable caller-owned results.
checks: Reject malformed messages, programmes, tranches, identifiers, dates, sizes, rates, and overrides with the specified codes and non-blank messages.
Any failure returns no securities, uses -1 for programme-level or the zero-based row index for row-level failures, and does not throw for described data quality errors.
Result lists are defensive unmodifiable copies even under direct record construction; inputs and generated CDM values remain unchanged.
